text: In both N=16 seeds, val_mse_ratio falls to about 0.23 by step 50, before accel_step forms and while force margin is still 0.004. Distance and energy margins are already 0.4-0.7 at that point. Is early next-step accuracy carried by distance and orbit-scale features, with accel_step and force forming only during the later refinement phase (val_mse_ratio 0.06 to 0.006)?
